formula: Gone are the days when + clause

formulas.formula: Gone are the days when + clause

example: Gone are the days when people waited weeks for an overseas letter.
exampleZh: 人們要等候數星期才收到海外信件的年代已經過去了。

examples.en: Gone are the days when people waited weeks for an overseas letter.
examples.zh: 人們要等候數星期才收到海外信件的年代已經過去了。
examples.highlight: Gone are the days when people waited weeks for an overseas letter.

rules.zh: 倒裝句 Gone are the days when... 要把 Gone 放在 be 動詞之前，再接主語 the days；不可把主語移到 are 前面。
rules.en: “Gone” is placed before the verb Gone are the days when people wrote every message by hand. Gone the days are when people wrote every message by hand. Gone + are + the days

rules.zh: 真正的主語是複數名詞 the days，因此要使用 are。
rules.en: The verb must be “are” The true subject is the plural noun the days, so the verb is are. Gone are the days when... Gone is the days when...

rules.zh: 在這個句型中，gone 表示「已成過去」或「已經消失」。它並不是一個被動語態，也不是表示某些日子「去了某個地方」。
在【when】後面的子句說明我們所指的是哪一段日子或哪一個年代。這裏的 when employees wrote every report by hand 修飾 the days。詞語【when】並不是用來提出問題，因此句末不使用問號。
rules.en: “When” describes which days Gone are the days when employees wrote every report by hand.

rules.zh: 在 Gone are the days when... 中，when 子句通常描述過去情況。可用一般過去式說明昔日習慣，用 used to 表示過往常態，用 had to 表示當時的必要，用 could／could not 表示能力或限制，也可用 was／were expected to 說明過去的社會期望。
rules.en: The “when” clause normally describes a past situation past simple when people paid every bill in cash used to + base verb when people used to store every photograph in an album had to + base verb when passengers had to wait without any travel information could / could not + base verb when students could pass by memorising facts alone was / were expected to + base verb when junior employees were expected to remain silent

rules.zh: 以【when】為例：子句直接修飾 the days，因此兩者之間不加逗號。
rules.en: Do not place a comma before “when” Gone are the days when every document was sent by fax. Gone are the days, when every document was sent by fax.

rules.zh: 前置範圍語或語氣副詞後面通常使用逗號。
rules.en: Use a comma after an introductory phrase In many workplaces, gone are the days when staff wore formal clothes every day. Thankfully, gone are the days when pupils were punished for asking questions.

rules.zh: 目標表達【Gone are the days when...】表示某種情況已經結束，或已不再是正常做法。如果某種情況只是略為減少，卻仍然十分普遍，便不應隨意使用這個句型。這句可能過於絕對，因為很多人仍然使用現金。對很多購物者而言，每次購物都攜帶現金的日子已成過去。 加入 For many shoppers 可以更準確地限制適用範圍。
rules.en: The expression makes a strong claim Gone are the days when... Too broad: Gone are the days when people use cash. More accurate: For many shoppers, gone are the days when they carried cash for every purchase. Gone are the days when + clause. In / At / Within + place, gone are the days when + clause. For + group, gone are the days when + clause. With + new development, gone are the days when + clause. Long gone are the days when + clause. For + group, long gone are the days when + clause. Thankfully / Fortunately / Sadly, gone are the days when + clause. For better or worse, gone are the days when + clause.

benefits.zh: 讀者可以立即明白，某種舊有習慣或情況現在已經不再普遍。
benefits.en: It makes a change between the past and present immediately clear The reader can immediately understand that an old habit or situation is no longer normal today.

benefits.zh: 你不需要分開兩句描述昔日情況和今天的改變，也可以把兩者合併成一句。第二句直接把「昔日的做法已經結束」放在同一句中，關係更清楚。
benefits.en: It combines the old situation and the present change Instead of explaining the past and present in two separate sentences, you can present the whole change in one sentence. Compare: People once had to visit a bank counter to pay every bill. They no longer need to do this. Gone are the days when people had to visit a bank counter to pay every bill.

benefits.zh: 以 Gone 開始句子，可以突出某個舊時代或舊做法已經結束。這特別適合用來討論：科技（technology）；教育（education）；工作模式交通（transport）；社會觀念公共服務
benefits.en: It gives strong emphasis to social or technological change Beginning with Gone draws attention to the fact that an old period has ended. working life social attitudes public services

benefits.zh: 你可以加入 thankfully、fortunately 或 sadly，表達你認為這項改變值得高興還是令人惋惜。值得慶幸的是，職場欺凌被置之不理的日子已經過去了。 令人惋惜的是，全家人每晚一起吃晚飯的日子已經過去了。
benefits.en: It allows you to show your attitude towards the change You can add thankfully, fortunately or sadly to show whether you see the change as positive or negative. Thankfully, gone are the days when workplace bullying was simply ignored. Sadly, gone are the days when the whole family ate dinner together every evening.

benefits.zh: 很多學習者經常以 People、Workers 或 Students 等主語開始句子。這個倒裝句能提供另一種句首寫法，使文章不會過於重複。
benefits.en: It gives you more varied sentence openings Many learners begin most sentences with the subject: People no longer... Workers no longer... Students no longer... Gone are the days when... gives you another way to organise and begin the sentence.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以先提出一項重要轉變，然後再解釋轉變的原因、影響或重要性，因此適合用於作文、報告、演說和討論。
benefits.en: It is useful in essays, reports, speeches and discussions The structure helps you introduce a major change before explaining its causes, effects or importance.

questions.answerZh: 在很多國際團隊之中，決定必須等候其他辦公室的文件送達的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: Across many international teams, gone are the days when decisions had to wait for documents to arrive from other offices.

questions.prompt: Job applicants used to post several printed copies of the same application. Most employers now accept digital forms.
questions.promptZh: 求職者以往要郵寄多份相同的紙本申請。大部分僱主現在都接受電子表格。
questions.answer: For most job applicants, gone are the days when they posted several printed copies of the same application.
questions.answerZh: 對大部分求職者而言，郵寄多份相同紙本申請的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: For most job applicants, gone are the days when they posted several printed copies of the same application.

questions.prompt: There was a time when students could pass the course by memorising facts alone. The assessment now requires explanation and application.
questions.promptZh: 學生以往只靠背誦資料便可以通過課程。現在的評核要求學生解釋和應用知識。
questions.answer: At this college, gone are the days when students could pass the course by memorising facts alone.
questions.answerZh: 在這所學院，學生只靠背誦資料便可以通過課程的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: At this college, gone are the days when students could pass the course by memorising facts alone.

questions.prompt: Many commuters no longer buy a separate monthly paper ticket because they can use one electronic travel card.
questions.promptZh: 很多通勤人士不再購買獨立的紙本月票，因為他們可以使用一張電子交通卡。
questions.answer: For many commuters, gone are the days when they had to buy a separate monthly paper ticket.
questions.answerZh: 對很多通勤人士而言，必須購買獨立紙本月票的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: For many commuters, gone are the days when they had to buy a separate monthly paper ticket.

questions.prompt: Long-distance relatives once had to plan expensive telephone calls carefully. Internet calling has removed much of that difficulty.
questions.promptZh: 相隔很遠的親友以往要仔細安排昂貴的長途電話。網絡通話已消除了大部分困難。
questions.answer: Long gone are the days when distant relatives had to plan every telephone call around its cost.
questions.answerZh: 相隔很遠的親友必須因應通話費用安排每次電話的日子早已一去不返。
questions.highlight: Long gone are the days when distant relatives had to plan every telephone call around its cost.

questions.prompt: The design team once worked in separate rooms and rarely shared early ideas. The new studio is open and collaborative.
questions.promptZh: 設計團隊以往在不同房間工作，很少分享初步構思。新的工作室採用開放和協作式設計。
questions.answer: Within the design team, gone are the days when people worked in separate rooms and rarely shared early ideas.
questions.answerZh: 在設計團隊內，成員各自在不同房間工作，而且很少分享初步構思的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: Within the design team, gone are the days when people worked in separate rooms and rarely shared early ideas.

questions.prompt: Shops used to throw away unsold food at the end of every day. New donation partnerships have largely ended that practice.
questions.promptZh: 商店以往每天結束營業時都會丟棄未售出的食物。新的食物捐贈合作計劃已大致終止這種做法。
questions.answer: In many participating shops, gone are the days when unsold food was thrown away at the end of every day.
questions.answerZh: 在很多參與計劃的商店，未售出的食物每天結束營業時被丟棄的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: In many participating shops, gone are the days when unsold food was thrown away at the end of every day.

questions.prompt: Scientists once needed months to process certain sets of data. Modern software can now complete the work much faster.
questions.promptZh: 科學家以往需要數月處理某些數據組。現代軟件現在可以更快完成這項工作。
questions.answer: In many laboratories, gone are the days when scientists needed months to process certain sets of data.
questions.answerZh: 在很多實驗室，科學家需要數月處理某些數據組的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: In many laboratories, gone are the days when scientists needed months to process certain sets of data.

questions.prompt: Some schools once punished pupils for asking questions that challenged the textbook. That attitude has changed.
questions.promptZh: 有些學校以往會懲罰提出問題、質疑課本內容的學生。這種態度已經改變。
questions.answer: Thankfully, gone are the days when pupils were punished for asking questions that challenged the textbook.
questions.answerZh: 值得慶幸的是，學生因提出質疑課本內容的問題而受到懲罰的日子已經過去了。
questions.highlight: Thankfully, gone are the days when pupils were punished for asking questions that challenged the textbook.

questions.prompt: In the past, customers had to explain the same problem again whenever a support call was transferred. The new system keeps a shared record.
questions.promptZh: 以往每當支援電話被轉駁時，顧客都要再次解釋同一個問題。新系統會保留共享紀錄。
questions.answer: With the new support system, gone are the days when customers had to explain the same problem after every transfer.
questions.answerZh: 有了新的支援系統，顧客每次被轉駁後都要再次解釋同一個問題的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: With the new support system, gone are the days when customers had to explain the same problem after every transfer.

questions.prompt: Remote communities once lost contact with medical specialists whenever bad weather blocked the roads. Telemedicine has greatly reduced that problem.
questions.promptZh: 偏遠社區以往每逢惡劣天氣令道路受阻，便會與專科醫生失去聯繫。遙距醫療已大大減少這個問題。
questions.answer: For many remote communities, gone are the days when bad weather completely cut them off from medical specialists.
questions.answerZh: 對很多偏遠社區而言，惡劣天氣令他們完全無法聯絡專科醫生的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: For many remote communities, gone are the days when bad weather completely cut them off from medical specialists.

questions.prompt: Junior employees here were once expected to agree silently with every senior colleague. The culture now encourages respectful disagreement.
questions.promptZh: 這裏的初級僱員以往被要求默默同意每位資深同事的意見。現在的文化鼓勵員工以尊重的方式提出不同意見。
questions.answer: In this workplace, gone are the days when junior employees were expected to agree silently with every senior colleague.
questions.answerZh: 在這個工作場所，初級僱員被要求默默同意每位資深同事意見的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: In this workplace, gone are the days when junior employees were expected to agree silently with every senior colleague.

questions.prompt: People once accepted that public buildings could be difficult for wheelchair users to enter. Modern access standards reject that idea.
questions.promptZh: 人們以往接受公共建築物可能令輪椅使用者難以進入。現代無障礙標準已否定這種觀念。
questions.answer: Thankfully, gone are the days when it was considered acceptable for public buildings to be difficult for wheelchair users to enter.
questions.answerZh: 值得慶幸的是，公共建築物令輪椅使用者難以進入仍被視為可以接受的日子已經過去了。
questions.highlight: Thankfully, gone are the days when it was considered acceptable for public buildings to be difficult for wheelchair users to enter.

questions.prompt: Local artists previously needed a gallery’s approval before a large audience could see their work. Digital platforms have created other routes.
questions.promptZh: 本地藝術家以往必須獲得畫廊批准，作品才能被大量觀眾看見。數碼平台已提供其他途徑。
questions.answer: For many local artists, gone are the days when reaching a large audience depended entirely on a gallery’s approval.
questions.answerZh: 對很多本地藝術家而言，要接觸大量觀眾完全取決於畫廊批准的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: For many local artists, gone are the days when reaching a large audience depended entirely on a gallery’s approval.

questions.prompt: Before automatic translation improved, travellers often carried several phrasebooks and still struggled with basic signs. That situation is now far less common.
questions.promptZh: 自動翻譯技術改善前，旅客經常攜帶數本常用語手冊，卻仍難以理解基本標示。這種情況現在已遠不如以往常見。
questions.answer: For many travellers, long gone are the days when they carried several phrasebooks and still struggled with basic signs.
questions.answerZh: 對很多旅客而言，攜帶數本常用語手冊卻仍難以理解基本標示的日子早已一去不返。
questions.highlight: For many travellers, long gone are the days when they carried several phrasebooks and still struggled with basic signs.

questions.prompt: A company’s environmental claims once went largely unquestioned because detailed data was difficult to obtain. Today, investors and the public can examine far more evidence.
questions.promptZh: 公司的環保聲明以往大多不受質疑，因為詳細數據難以取得。現在，投資者和公眾可以查閱更多證據。
questions.answer: In many markets, gone are the days when a company’s environmental claims went largely unquestioned.
questions.answerZh: 在很多市場，公司的環保聲明大多不受質疑的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: In many markets, gone are the days when a company’s environmental claims went largely unquestioned.

questions.prompt: There was a time when a single national broadcast decided what almost everyone watched at the same hour. On-demand services have broken up that shared schedule.
questions.promptZh: 以往一個全國廣播節目會決定幾乎所有人在同一時間收看甚麼。點播服務已打破這種共同收看時間表。
questions.answer: For better or worse, gone are the days when a single national broadcast decided what almost everyone watched at the same hour.
questions.answerZh: 不論好壞，一個全國廣播節目決定幾乎所有人在同一時間收看甚麼的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: For better or worse, gone are the days when a single national broadcast decided what almost everyone watched at the same hour.

questions.prompt: In some organisations, career progress once depended more on being seen at a desk than on the quality of the work produced. Outcome-based assessment has replaced that approach.
questions.promptZh: 在某些機構，事業發展以往更取決於是否被看見坐在辦公桌前，而不是工作成果的質素。以成果為本的評核已取代這種方式。
questions.answer: In those organisations, gone are the days when career progress depended more on being seen at a desk than on the quality of the work produced.
questions.answerZh: 在那些機構，事業發展更取決於是否被看見坐在辦公桌前，而不是工作成果質素的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: In those organisations, gone are the days when career progress depended more on being seen at a desk than on the quality of the work produced.

questions.prompt: People in much of this region no longer simply accept severe flooding as an unavoidable part of every rainy season because new drainage systems have greatly reduced the risk.
questions.promptZh: 這個地區很多地方的居民不再把嚴重水浸視為每個雨季都無法避免的事情，因為新的排水系統已大大降低風險。
questions.answer: In much of this region, gone are the days when severe flooding was simply accepted as an unavoidable part of every rainy season.
questions.answerZh: 在這個地區很多地方，嚴重水浸被視為每個雨季都無法避免的日子已成過去。
questions.highlight: In much of this region, gone are the days when severe flooding was simply accepted as an unavoidable part of every rainy season.
